|game_text=Deploy on table. While you occupy Tatooine system, your Force generation is +1 at Tatooine sites you occupy with a trooper and, during your deploy phase, may exchange a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper in hand with one in Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Send A Detachment Down (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Send A Detachment Down (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 18 June 2023<ref name="ht-781a0de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Dark/large/sendadetachmentdown.gif</code> as published 18 June 2023: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/781a0de1bab57c271fca72a4887b826bb1a30838/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Dark/large/sendadetachmentdown.gif holotable commit 781a0de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. While you occupy Tatooine system, your Force generation is +1 at Tatooine sites you occupy with a trooper and, during your deploy phase, may exchange a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper in hand with one in Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Send A Detachment Down (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 2, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploy on table. While you occupy Tatooine system, your Force generation is +1 at Tatooine sites you occupy with a trooper and, during your deploy phase, may exchange a non-[Maintenance] Imperial trooper in hand with one in Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Send A Detachment Down (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Send A Detachment Down”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Send A Detachment Down (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Send A Detachment Down]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
